sampleGuidance.samplingNote: Minimum five exploratory sessions per priority segment is a recruitment target, not statistical significance or proof of PMF.
sampleGuidance.userAssistedFirstTrial: record actual minutes/steps, errors and reason, no mandatory success rate inferred
sampleGuidance.naturalReuseDefinition: User has their own real repeat problem and voluntarily invokes same fixed tool without AI/creator assistance; forced demo reruns do not count.
sampleGuidance.costAndRisk: Document native/Node and first AI model costs, tasks done, data permissions, no private credentials or sensitive fields in research artifacts.
sampleGuidance.stopWhen: No legal authorization; best existing workflow simpler or cheaper; repeated work absent; first-use pain exceeds savings; customer rejects source/data scope

crossStudyMandatoryQuestions: What exact task do you repeat? Show the last two occurrences (with PII safely excluded).
How many minutes/steps did each of the last two occurrences take?
Which built-in website feature or product already solves this? What is its actual cost?
What result is considered correct? What types of failure are unacceptable?
Which website/action/data do you have legal authority to allow a browser tool to use?
Would you approve code/permission/version changes? Who in your organization owns that decision?
Would you voluntarily use the same tool a second time without speaking to AI? Which trigger?
Do you already pay for alternative software, and who is the buyer? Ask for non-sensitive verified amount only if willing.
How long can this local tool be maintained as the site changes? Who pays for maintenance?
Would a lower-friction built-in button or a text macro be enough instead of a full browser tool?
